classes.title: Test skipped instead of fixed
classes.gapNotes: Only xUnit Skip attributes are covered. NUnit and MSTest ignore forms and environment-gated early returns are missed; legitimate platform-specific skips use the same token and are also refused.

classes.title: Assertion softened to a tautology
classes.gapNotes: Only the listed literal tautologies are covered. Replacing equality with a null check, widening a numeric tolerance or copying the observed value into an expected value is not analyzed.

classes.title: Test body emptied instead of fixed
classes.gapNotes: Only an empty block under an xUnit attribute is covered. Deleted tests, NUnit or MSTest attributes, expression-bodied tests and setup without assertions are missed. Empty methods without a test attribute are deliberately permitted.

classes.title: Nullable context switched off in a file
classes.gapNotes: Only the source directive is covered, including deliberate disables in maintained generated files. Project-wide Nullable properties and a project that never enabled nullable checks are outside these source paths.

classes.title: NoWarn widened to bury a real diagnostic
classes.gapNotes: Only the listed diagnostic-id spellings inside NoWarn are covered. Numeric-only ids, WarningsNotAsErrors and other suppression forms are missed. XML comments are not blanked, so a matching commented-out property can also fire.

classes.title: TreatWarningsAsErrors turned off
classes.gapNotes: Only unconditioned elements in the listed form are covered. Properties with attributes, deletion of a property and command-line changes are missed. XML comments are not blanked, so commented-out matching settings can also fire.

classes.title: Test run narrowed by a filter

fixtures.violation:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<RunSettings>
  <RunConfiguration>
    <ResultsDirectory>./TestResults</ResultsDirectory>
    <TreatNoTestsAsError>true</TreatNoTestsAsError>
    <TestCaseFilter>(TestCategory != Flaky) & (TestCategory != Integration)</TestCaseFilter>
  </RunConfiguration>
  <LoggerRunSettings>
    <Loggers>
      <Logger friendlyName="trx" enabled="True" />
    </Loggers>
  </LoggerRunSettings>
</RunSettings>

classes.gapNotes: Only exclusionary filters in the listed project and runsettings files are covered. Inclusive filters and command-line or workflow filters are missed. XML comments are not blanked, so a commented-out matching filter can also fire.

classes.title: A run that discovers no tests still exits zero
classes.gapNotes: Only an explicit false setting is covered. A missing runsettings file, a deleted true setting and a test project omitted from its solution are missed. XML comments are not blanked, so commented-out matching settings can also fire.

classes.title: Test harness config relaxed instead of the failure fixed

fixtures.violation:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<RunSettings>
  <RunConfiguration>
    <ResultsDirectory>./TestResults</ResultsDirectory>
    <TestSessionTimeout>600000</TestSessionTimeout>
  </RunConfiguration>
  <DataCollectionRunSettings>
    <DataCollectors>
      <DataCollector friendlyName="XPlat code coverage">
        <Configuration>
          <CollectCoverage>false</CollectCoverage>
          <Threshold>10</Threshold>
        </Configuration>
      </DataCollector>
    </DataCollectors>
  </DataCollectionRunSettings>
  <LoggerRunSettings>
    <Loggers>
      <Logger friendlyName="trx" enabled="False" />
    </Loggers>
  </LoggerRunSettings>
</RunSettings>

classes.gapNotes: Only the listed runsettings values are covered. Threshold reductions that stay above the pattern limit, deleted settings, project properties and command-line overrides are missed. The separate zero-tests check handles TreatNoTestsAsError.
